question: How many support tickets were filed in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM support_tickets

question: How many orders were placed by customers in Europe?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'EU'

question: What was the total net revenue in APAC?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM revenue WHERE region = 'APAC'

question: How many refunds were issued because of duplicate charges?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunds FROM refunds WHERE reason = 'duplicate_charge'

question: What is the total amount refunded for duplicate charges?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount)::numeric, 2) AS refunded FROM refunds WHERE reason = 'duplicate_charge'

question: How many critical support tickets did European customers open?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM support_tickets t JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'EU' AND t.severity = 'critical'

question: Which region had the highest net revenue in March 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT region FROM revenue WHERE date >= '2025-03-01' AND date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many billing tickets did European customers open between 2025-04-15 and 2025-04-28?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM support_tickets t JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'EU' AND t.category = 'billing' AND t.created_at >= '2025-04-15' AND t.created_at < '2025-04-29'

question: What was Europe's net revenue from 2025-04-01 to 2025-04-14?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM revenue WHERE region = 'EU' AND date >= '2025-04-01' AND date < '2025-04-15'

question: What is the average resolution time in hours for critical support tickets?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(resolution_time)::numeric, 1) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE severity = 'critical'

question: How many customers are there in each region?
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: Which product generated the most gross order revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(o.revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What changed in release v3.2?
reference_answer: Release v3.2 (April 15 2025) updated the checkout payment workflow and added an automatic payment retry mechanism; European customers then reported duplicate payment attempts.

question: What did the v3.2.1 hotfix fix?
reference_answer: The v3.2.1 hotfix (May 2 2025) rolled back the v3.2 automatic payment retry changes and added idempotency keys so retried payments cannot charge twice.

question: What caused the APAC dashboard slowdown in March?
reference_answer: A misconfigured cache node in the Singapore data center caused elevated dashboard load times for APAC customers from March 10 to 14 2025.

question: What discount did the North America spring campaign offer?
reference_answer: A 10% discount on all products for North American customers, from April 10 to April 30 2025.

question: What was the root cause of the checkout failures?
reference_answer: Incorrect retry handling in release v3.2 caused duplicate payment attempts.

question: Which customer reported being charged twice in support ticket 1001?
reference_answer: EuroRetail GmbH, a critical-severity European customer, was charged twice during checkout after release v3.2.

question: Why did revenue drop in Europe?
reference_answer: EU net revenue fell after release v3.2 on April 15 2025: a payment-retry bug caused duplicate charges (refunded) and failed checkouts for European customers. Support tickets, mostly billing, spiked at the same time.

question: Why did billing tickets spike in Europe in late April 2025?
reference_answer: Release v3.2's payment retry bug charged European customers twice, producing a spike in billing and duplicate-charge tickets after April 15 2025.

question: Why did refunds increase in late April 2025?
reference_answer: Duplicate-charge refunds for European customers rose after release v3.2's payment retry bug; most new refunds have the reason duplicate_charge.

question: Why did APAC performance tickets spike in March 2025?
reference_answer: A misconfigured cache node in Singapore slowed APAC dashboards from March 10 to 14 2025, causing performance tickets; there was no revenue impact.

question: Why did North America revenue rise in April 2025?
reference_answer: The North America spring campaign (10% discount, April 10 to 30 2025) sharply increased order volume, so NA net revenue in April was higher than in March even after the discount.

question: Did the v3.2.1 hotfix help European revenue recover?
reference_answer: Yes. After the v3.2.1 hotfix on May 2 2025, duplicate-charge problems declined and EU weekly revenue recovered toward pre-release levels by mid-May.

question: Why did revenue drop in North America in April 2025?
reference_answer: North America net revenue was higher in April 2025 than in March, because of the spring campaign. The question wrongly assumes it dropped.

question: Why did APAC revenue collapse in March 2025?
reference_answer: APAC revenue did not collapse in March 2025; the March dashboard slowdown had no measurable impact on orders or revenue. The question wrongly assumes a collapse.

question: Why did support tickets in Europe decrease after release v3.2?
reference_answer: European support tickets increased sharply after release v3.2, mostly billing and duplicate-charge complaints. The question wrongly assumes they decreased.

question: Why did the North America spring campaign cause duplicate charges?
reference_answer: The spring campaign did not cause duplicate charges; they came from the release v3.2 payment retry bug and affected European customers. The question wrongly blames the campaign.

question: What was revenue in Europe in June 2025?
reference_answer: There is no data for June 2025; the data only covers March 1 to May 31 2025.
